en.title: Chat Mention Counter
en.description:
Process messages and offline events in event order. A message sender becomes an existing and active user when they post. A mention token can be a user ID, ALL, or HERE; ALL covers all existing users, and HERE covers currently active users. Each user is counted at most once per message; self-mentions count. Output the IDs with positive counts and their counts, sorted lexicographically by ID.

Rules follow the original OAMaster problem; the input/output protocol and bounds marked "site-added" were compiled by this site.
en.input:
q (1≤q≤1000). Then q lines follow: MESSAGE sender timestamp m token1..tokenm, or OFFLINE user. m≥0, and IDs have the form id followed by a positive integer; timestamps are non-negative integers, and events are processed in input order. The total number of direct mention tokens is ≤200000; q≤1000 is a site-added limit on the expanded size.

Site-added ranges: user IDs are id followed by a decimal integer in 1..10^9, and timestamp is 0..10^9;
en.output: Output id=count entries sorted lexicographically by ID, separated by spaces; if there are no counts, output an empty line.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for details.
